items.title: Fiddlehead & Walter Schreifels Cover Sick Of It All In Tribute To Lou Koller
items.summary: Last week, New York hardcore staples Sick Of It All announced the tragic death of their frontman Lou Koller after a battle with cancer. Santa Cruz's Drain paid tribute by covering Sick Of It All's 1995 track "It's Clobberin' Time" at the revived Warped Tour in Long Beach, and last night Fiddlehead did the same in Brooklyn at the Warsaw.
